description: This Java class defines a command for creating a new Thing in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates the full Thing object, optional initial policies, and supports copying policies from existing ones. The class includes methods for instantiation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and identification of the entity to be created.

classes.name: CreateThing
classes.description: Immutable command class for creating new Thing instances with optional initial policies and policy copying features, with JSON serialization/deserialization and entity identification.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new command to create a Thing with a specified initial policy.

methods.name: withCopiedPolicy
methods.description: Creates a new command to create a Thing by copying a policy from an existing policy ID or placeholder.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string or object and creates a CreateThing command instance.

methods.name: getThing
methods.description: Returns the Thing object that this command will create.

methods.name: getInitialPolicy
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the initial policy JSON if set.

methods.name: getPolicyIdOrPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the policy ID or placeholder used for copying policies.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing entity to be created.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the complete JSON representation of the entity to be created, including policies.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer for the resource path, fixed as empty for creation commands.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Builds the JSON payload for the command, including Thing and policy information.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the command category, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new CreateThing command with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates that this command changes authorization settings.
